question: Which among the following is an autobiography of Michelle Obama?
solution:
The correct option is __**Becoming.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Michelle Obama** is an American lawyer, author, and former **First Lady of the United States.**
 
• **Becoming **is an autobiography of **Michelle Obama**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **"Me"** is a memoir of **Elton John, a British musician, and songwriter.**
 
• **"Our House is on Fire"** is a book written by **Greta Thunberg,** a Swedish environmental activist, and her family.
 
• **"My Life"** is an autobiography of **Bill Clinton, **a former President of the United States.
